preservation: board columns and Call in / Mark done / Back flow
notes: Reviewer reading of the code before any advise call: /waiting is a 3-column board of white cards on neutral-100 columns; each card shows name, reason, scheduled start, practitioner, and Back / Call in buttons. There is NO check-in timestamp in the Appointment model (only start HH:MM), so the implementation must add checkedInAt (set in setAppointmentStatus, seeded for sample checked-in rows) and a ticking elapsed-time readout. Expected design: per-card wait duration in tabular figures, escalating tone (neutral -> warning -> danger) at thresholds with a text label so colour is not the only carrier, longest-waiting sorted first or at least visibly flagged, column header showing longest wait, no layout shift as minutes tick, no dark mode, no new nav, reuse Badge/Button. Mode: polish/refactor of an existing screen (small feature on existing UI); 'create' acceptable since it adds a new element.
